explanation: I is zero by odd symmetry. II is also zero: sin(x) cancels on [-π,π], and cos(x) cancels over a full period (also by symmetry about π/2 on [0,π]). III equals (7/8)ln(513/33), which is nonzero. Thus I and II are zero, but that choice is missing. Option d applies only if 'due to symmetry' is restricted to the entire integrand being odd about zero; the wording does not specify that restriction.
